name: Photon
tagline: Open-source OSM geocoder with autocomplete from Komoot
description: Photon is Komoot's free open-source geocoder built on OpenStreetMap and Elasticsearch. It provides forward/reverse geocoding and typeahead place search via a public demo at photon.komoot.io, plus self-host options.

auth.details: Public demo endpoint requires no authentication; self-hosted instances may add their own auth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public demo is free with fair-use expectations; no published paid plans for the demo.

rate_limits: not published for public demo; self-host for production load
use_cases: autocomplete place names as a user types
forward-geocode an address or place name to coordinates
reverse-geocode lat/lon to a place name
bias search results to a map viewport or location
